name: Arey Chup Ho Jao Papiyon
visual_description: Akshay Kumar gesturing frantically to silence an arguing crowd of men including Johnny Lever and Sunil Shetty in Deewane Huye Paagal.
usage_context: Used to shut down loud, chaotic debates, ridiculous suggestions, or group chat mayhem.

example.top_text: When everyone in the family group starts sharing unverified WhatsApp forwards

text_areas.description: Situation causing chaotic or annoying discussions
